importScreen.guide.step1.title: Step 1: Buy the Game
importScreen.guide.step1.item1: Create and sign in to your account on GOG.com
importScreen.guide.step1.item2: Search and purchase your game (for example Terraria, Stardew Valley)
importScreen.guide.step1.item3: If you already own the game, skip this step
importScreen.guide.step2.title: Step 2: Download the Installer
importScreen.guide.step2.item1: Click your avatar on GOG.com and open My Games
importScreen.guide.step2.item2: Find your game and open its download page
importScreen.guide.step3.title: Step 3: Download ModLoader (Optional)
importScreen.guide.step3.smapiLinux: Download the SMAPI Linux installer package
importScreen.guide.step4.title: Step 4: Import into Launcher
importScreen.guide.step4.item1: Tap Game File on the right and choose the downloaded .sh or .zip file
importScreen.guide.step4.item2: If needed, tap ModLoader and select the corresponding file
importScreen.guide.step4.item3: Confirm the detection result above is correct
importScreen.guide.step4.item4: Tap Start Import and wait for installation to finish
importScreen.guide.step4.item5: Return to the game list to launch the game
